national_news.title: DGHS Issues Warning Against Reuse of Single-Use Medical Devices
bullets: The Director General of Health Services (DGHS) cautioned public and private healthcare facilities against reusing single-use medical devices and disposable surgical items.
The practice is frequently observed in critical specialties like Cardiology, Nephrology, Oncology, Neurosurgery, and Cardiothoracic Surgery.
Reusing such items poses severe health risks, including cross-infection, device malfunction, procedure complications, and compromises patient safety.

national_news.title: India Chem 2026 Concludes in Mumbai Highlighting Global Chemical Hub Status
bullets: The 14th edition of India Chem 2026 was held in Mumbai with the theme 'Advantage Bharat : An Emerging Global Chemicals Hub'.
The event was jointly organized by the Department of Chemicals & Petrochemicals and FICCI, with Japan as the official partner country.
Roundtable discussions and forums focused on specialty chemicals, agrochemicals, infrastructure, and international trade collaborations with Japan, the US, and the EU.

national_news.title: Centre Achieves Target of Creating 11 Crore Farmer IDs Ahead of Schedule
bullets: The Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers' Welfare achieved the milestone of creating 11 crore Farmer IDs five months ahead of the March 2027 deadline.
Implemented under the Digital Agriculture Mission, approved by the Union Cabinet on September 2, 2024.
Provides farmers with a unique digital identity for transparent access to government schemes, bank loans, crop insurance, and disaster relief.

national_news.title: SEBI Chairman Highlights Retail Broking Growth and Capital Market Metrics
bullets: SEBI Chairman Tuhin Kanta Pandey stated that the next wave of retail broking will emerge from smaller towns and villages.
India's equity market capitalization stands at approximately Rs 470 lakh crore, with Mutual Fund AUM around Rs 83 lakh crore and over 15 crore unique investors.
SEBI highlighted concerns regarding unregistered financial influencers and noted that its 'Samajh Se Investing Simple' campaign crossed 15 crore views.

national_news.title: Government to Bear Entire Cost of Certification for MSMEs under Export Promotion Mission
bullets: Commerce and Industry Minister Piyush Goyal announced that the government will bear the entire cost of expensive certifications for micro and small enterprises under the Export Promotion Mission (EPM).
The EPM has a total outlay of Rs 25,060 crore over six financial years, implemented through two sub-schemes: Niryat Protsahan (Rs 10,401 crore) and Niryat Disha (Rs 14,659 crore).
The support aims to help Indian businesses access global markets and comply with European Union requirements such as the Carbon Border Adjustment Mechanism and EU Deforestation Regulation.

national_news.title: Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman Chairs 30th FSDC Meeting
bullets: Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman chaired the 30th meeting of the Financial Stability and Development Council (FSDC) in New Delhi.
The council reviewed the 'Your Money, Your Right' campaign to expedite the refund of unclaimed assets like bank deposits, shares, and insurance proceeds to their rightful owners.
The meeting deliberated on simplifying KYC procedures, enhancing cybersecurity preparedness, fintech innovation, and tokenisation of financial assets.

national_news.title: Defence Minister Addresses Army Commanders' Conference, Releases Land Warfare Doctrine
bullets: Defence Minister Rajnath Singh addressed the Army Commanders' Conference in New Delhi, emphasizing a 20 to 30-year long-term strategic vision for future warfare.
Released the new Land Warfare Doctrine to provide an overarching framework for future conflicts and multi-domain capabilities.
Highlighted that domestic defence production reached Rs 1.78 lakh crore and defence exports touched an all-time high of around Rs 38,000 crore in FY 2025-26.

national_news.title: India Emerges as Third-Largest Arms Exporter to Europe
bullets: India has emerged as the third-largest arms exporter to Europe, supported by the EU's 'ReArm Europe' initiative and domestic manufacturing growth.
Total defence exports reached an all-time high of Rs 38,424 crore (approx. 3.6 billion euros), supplying equipment to over 80 countries.
The government aims to allocate 75% of annual defence capital expenditure to domestic products under the Make in India initiative.

national_news.title: India Records Best-Ever Haul of 114 Medals at Asian Para Games 2026
bullets: India concluded its campaign at the 5th Asian Para Games in Aichi-Nagoya, Japan, with a record-breaking haul of 114 medals (30 gold, 35 silver, and 49 bronze).
Double gold medallists Nishad Kumar and Mona Agarwal served as India's flag-bearers at the closing ceremony.
India surpassed its previous best tally of 108 medals achieved at the 2023 Hangzhou Asian Para Games.

national_news.title: 19th Urban Mobility India Conference and Exhibition 2026 Inaugurated in Bhubaneswar
bullets: The 19th Urban Mobility India (UMI) Conference and Exhibition 2026 was inaugurated in Bhubaneswar by Union Minister of State for Housing and Urban Affairs Tokhan Sahu.

The event is organized by the Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs (MoHUA) through the Institute of Urban Transport (India) with support from the Government of Odisha, focusing on the theme 'Urban Accessibility and Liveability in Digital Age'.
India's operational metro network has expanded significantly from 248 km in 2014 to over 1,185 km across 26 cities, with another 998 km under construction.

national_news.title: MoS Pabitra Margherita Visits Samoa and Nauru to Strengthen Bilateral Ties
bullets: Minister of State for External Affairs Pabitra Margherita undertook an official visit to Samoa and Nauru from October 16 to 22, 2026, to bolster cooperation under the Forum for India-Pacific Islands Cooperation (FIPIC) framework.
An MoU on the implementation of the SENESE Project was signed in Samoa to promote the inclusion and development of children and persons with disabilities.
Engagements in Nauru featured the flagging off of a mini-cycling event under India's Quick Impact Project (QIP) titled 'Cycling for a Stronger Nauru' and interactions with ITEC and ICCR alumni.

national_news.title: Prime Minister Inaugurates Chinmaya Amrit Mahotsav Global Sammelan in New Delhi
bullets: Prime Minister Narendra Modi inaugurated the Chinmaya Amrit Mahotsav Global Sammelan at Bharat Mandapam, marking the culmination of 75 years of the Chinmaya Mission founded in 1951.
The Prime Minister highlighted that over 650 stolen ancient idols and antiquities have been successfully brought back to India from abroad over the past twelve years.
He emphasized that the National Education Policy (NEP) aligns education with New India's needs, integrating mother tongues, modern science, and rich cultural traditions.

national_news.title: Strategic Communication Key to Sustainable Mass Transit: UMI Conference
bullets: A roundtable on 'Behaviour Change and Public Communication' was chaired by PIB ADG Akhil Kumar Mishra on the sidelines of the 19th UMI Conference in Bhubaneswar.
Experts emphasized integrating strategic public communication and behavioral interventions into urban transport planning to reduce private vehicle dependence.
The panel highlighted the need to eliminate 'information shadows' in slums and peripheral areas through hyper-local communication strategies.

national_news.title: Centre Launches AATAL Facility for Real-Time Air Pollution Analysis in Delhi-NCR
bullets: Union Minister Jitendra Singh inaugurated the Integrated Atmospheric Chemistry and Aerosol Toxicity Analysis Laboratory (AATAL) at the Indian Institute of Tropical Meteorology's (IITM) Delhi branch.
Established under 'Mission Mausam' by the Ministry of Earth Sciences, AATAL is billed as the world's first-of-its-kind integrated air pollution analysis facility.
The facility integrates with IITM's AIRWISE system to provide 72-hour air-quality forecasts at a spatial resolution of 400 metres to aid bodies like the Commission for Air Quality Management (CAQM).

national_news.title: Viksit Bharat - Guarantee for Rozgar and Ajeevika Mission (Gramin) Framework Rolled Out
bullets: The Viksit Bharat - Guarantee for Rozgar and Ajeevika Mission (Gramin) (VB-G RAM G) Act, 2025 came into force on 1 July 2026, succeeding Mahatma Gandhi NREGA.
The Act provides a statutory guarantee of 125 days of wage employment every financial year for every rural household volunteering for unskilled manual work.
It focuses on four thematic areas: water security, core rural infrastructure, livelihood-related infrastructure, and mitigation of extreme weather events using Viksit Gram Panchayat Plans (VGPPs).

national_news.title: Govt to Bear Full Cost of International Certifications for MSEs under EPM
bullets: Union Commerce and Industry Minister Piyush Goyal announced that the government will bear the full cost of international certifications for Micro and Small Enterprises (MSEs) under the Export Promotion Mission (EPM).
The assistance aims to help Indian exporters comply with global regulatory requirements, including the European Union's Carbon Border Adjustment Mechanism (CBAM) and EU Deforestation Regulation.
Approved with a total outlay of ₹25,060 crore over six financial years, the EPM operates through two sub-schemes: Niryat Protsahan (₹10,401 crore) and Niryat Disha (₹14,659 crore).

national_news.title: India Women Defeat Zimbabwe by Nine Wickets in First ODI
bullets: India Women's cricket team beat Zimbabwe by nine wickets in Vadodara to take a 1-0 lead in the three-match ODI series.
Pratika Rawal scored an unbeaten century (100 off 96 balls) and was named Player of the Match, while spinner Shree Charani took career-best figures of 4 for 23.
The match marked Smriti Mandhana's first ODI as India's full-time captain following an eight-month gap in the 50-over format for the team.

national_news.title: India and China Agree to Utilize Diplomatic and Military Channels for LAC Management
bullets: The Ministry of External Affairs (MEA) stated that India and China agreed to discuss measures to improve understanding of the Line of Actual Control (LAC) and prevent border miscalculations.
MEA spokesperson Randhir Jaiswal confirmed that India continues to transport life-saving medicines to Iran as a humanitarian gesture despite regional flight connectivity challenges.
The ministry confirmed the safety of 14 Indian nationals in Hodeidah, Yemen, and facilitated the return of over 13,000 Umrah pilgrims stranded in Saudi Arabia.

national_news.title: President Murmu Addresses Bastar Dussehra Festival and Muria Darbar in Chhattisgarh
bullets: President Droupadi Murmu highlighted combined central and state efforts in overcoming Naxalism during her visit to the Bastar Dussehra Festival in Jagdalpur, Chhattisgarh.
The President attended the traditional 'Muria Darbar' at Sirhasar Bhavan, emphasizing its role as a democratic platform for tribal communities to air grievances to leaders.
Emphasized equitable development for tribal entrepreneurs and youth to contribute towards the national goal of 'Viksit Bharat @2047'.

national_news.title: India Counters Pakistan's Allegations on Religious Freedom at United Nations
bullets: First Secretary at India's Permanent Mission to the UN, Bhavika Mangalanandan, rejected Pakistan's statements during a discussion on the UN Special Rapporteur's interim report.
India highlighted the respectful burial of Pakistani soldiers by the Indian Army with military honours during the 1999 Kargil War, despite Pakistan's initial refusal to claim them.
Criticized Pakistan's minority rights record and urged UN reports to give due weight to the human rights of terrorism victims rather than selectively highlighting concerns.

national_news.title: Satellite-Tagged Amur Falcons Complete Migration Journey to Manipur
bullets: Two satellite-tagged Amur Falcons, named 'Apapang' and 'Alang', returned to Manipur after migrating across 23 countries in Asia and Africa.
The birds were tagged by scientists from the Wildlife Institute of India (WII) and traveled from their breeding grounds in northeastern China in 11 days.
After stopovers in the Tamenglong district of Manipur, the falcons will undertake a non-stop 6,000 km flight to Somalia, including a 3,000 km Arabian Sea crossing.

national_news.title: CAQM Reviews Paddy Stubble Management Measures in Punjab
bullets: A high-level team from the Commission for Air Quality Management (CAQM) conducted field reviews in Ropar, Hoshiarpur, and Amritsar districts of Punjab.
The review assessed in-situ and ex-situ Crop Residue Management (CRM) measures, including biomass plants, Krishi Vigyan Kendra machinery availability, and Compressed Bio-Gas (CBG) plants.
CAQM directed state authorities to enforce compulsory co-firing targets of paddy stubble in thermal power plants to curb stubble burning incidents in NCR and adjoining areas.

national_news.title: India's Data Centre Capacity Projected to Reach 8,000 MW by CY30
bullets: India's data centre capacity increased from 375 MW in CY20 to 1,575 MW in 2026, with projections to expand to 8,000 MW by CY30.
Ministry of Power estimates data centre electricity demand will reach 17 GW by 2031-32, with sector investments scaling from Rs 0.36 trillion in FY26 to Rs 1.31 trillion by FY32.
To manage high resource consumption—where a 100MW facility requires up to 2.5 billion litres of water annually—innovative technologies like deep seawater cooling are being explored.

national_news.title: C-DAC and Bank of India Partner to Develop Quantum Technologies for Banking
bullets: The Centre for Development of Advanced Computing (C-DAC) signed an MoU with Bank of India to co-develop indigenous quantum technologies for the financial sector.
The partnership aims to build a Quantum Ecosystem for Financial Innovation, focusing on quantum-safe technologies, operational resilience, and advanced cybersecurity.
Scope of collaboration extends to AI-driven fraud detection, credit analytics, smart contracts, blockchain applications, and technical capacity-building.

national_news.title: DDWS Organises Virtual Conference on Convergence of Jal Jeevan Mission 2.0 and 16th Finance Commission
bullets: The Department of Drinking Water and Sanitation (DDWS), Ministry of Jal Shakti, conducted a national virtual conference emphasizing convergence between Jal Jeevan Mission (JJM) 2.0 and 16th Finance Commission grants.

With JJM 2.0, the core focus has shifted from initial infrastructure creation to long-term functionality, source sustainability, and robust Operation & Maintenance (O&M) of rural drinking water systems.

Gram Panchayats are tasked under the 73rd Constitutional Amendment to lead annual O&M planning, utilizing tied Rural Local Body (RLB) grants for maintaining service delivery and source sustainability.

bihar_news.title: Bihar Government Introduces 100-Point Performance Index to Rank Banks
bullets: The Bihar government has introduced a 100-point performance assessment index for the first time to rank operating banks in the state, led by IDFC FIRST Bank with 74 points.
Banks are classified into three zones: Green Zone (11 banks scoring 50 or above), Yellow Zone (7 banks), and Red Zone (includes several leading public sector banks).
Bihar set an annual credit plan target of ₹4.95 lakh crore for FY 2026-27, achieving 38.25 per cent (₹1.89 lakh crore) as of September 30.
